summary: Frontend-only retest of the GlicoTrack repeated-edit regression AFTER iteration 5 refactor of /app/frontend/src/editStore.ts (token-based snapshot {id, token}) and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (handledTokenRef one-shot gate, clearEditRequest no longer called). REGRESSION IS STILL PRESENT. Reproduced on https://insulin-daily.preview.emergentagent.com in viewport 390x844, in two independent runs. TEST A (first edit of a fresh session) PASSES: banner=True, glucose prefilled. TEST B (second edit, different row, after save-updating the first) FAILS: banner=False, glucose='' empty, header stays 'Nuova Misurazione'. Because TEST B blocks execution (no cancel-edit-button to click), TEST C and TEST D could not be exercised in sequence - but behavior matches iteration_4 symptoms exactly, so they will also fail. Update does NOT duplicate (count stays 2 after save). Save during TEST A sets glucose=200 correctly on row1. Export PDF button and empty-data info toast flows were not re-verified in this iteration (not the regression under test) but worked in iteration_4. No red-screen; only cosmetic 'shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' RN-web deprecation warnings.

ui_bugs.component: Repeated-edit flow (src/editStore.ts token snapshot + app/(tabs)/index.tsx handledTokenRef gate)
ui_bugs.issue: HIGH REGRESSION NOT FIXED. After the iteration 5 refactor, only the FIRST edit still works. Observed in a clean run: added glucose 120 Prima Pranzo and glucose 90 Notte -> Storico shows 2 rows (Notte top, Prima Pranzo bottom). TEST A: tap edit on top row -> banner shows, glucose=90, changed to 200, saved (row count stayed 2). TEST B: back to Storico, tap edit on OTHER row (Prima Pranzo id) -> banner stays HIDDEN, glucose input empty, header stays 'Nuova Misurazione'. Same symptom as iteration_4 even though the proximate cause we suspected (clearEditRequest inside the subscriber's useEffect) was removed. The token-based snapshot alone did not resolve it, which suggests the real issue is lower-level: on react-native-web + Expo Router (tabs), the Inserimento subscriber of useSyncExternalStore does not reliably receive the SECOND requestEdit emission. Possible root causes to investigate: (1) the tab screen is actually unmounted on blur in this build so handledTokenRef(0) is fresh but React commits getSnapshot BEFORE the subscribe() is wired, and the first-mount snapshot is already the handled state -- then useMeasurements data has not loaded yet, early-returning without latching handledTokenRef, and when data later arrives the editRequest reference is the same (no re-trigger because the dep is a ref-stable object) ; (2) the subscriber's cached snapshot in useSyncExternalStore is kept stable across unmount/mount via React 19's cache; (3) Expo Router navigate('/') resolves after the state mutation but before React has flushed the new snapshot. Any of these can be side-stepped by moving the edit intent into a value that is READ fresh on screen focus, e.g. useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { const req = getEditRequestSnapshot(); if (req.id && req.token !== handledTokenRef.current) { prefill(req); } }, [data])) - i.e. drive the prefill from a focus effect that polls the snapshot, instead of from a subscription effect.

integration_issues.flow: Second (and subsequent) edit from Storico -> Inserisci
integration_issues.issue: useSyncExternalStore subscription in Inserimento does not re-fire the prefill useEffect on the second requestEdit() emission in this preview environment. Fix needs to switch away from relying on the subscriber callback to drive prefill after tab navigation. Suggested approaches to try, in order of preference: (a) read the edit request via useFocusEffect each time Inserimento gains focus - this triggers deterministically after router.navigate('/'); (b) keep the external store but ALSO read it via a non-subscribed getter inside a useFocusEffect, latching handledTokenRef and prefilling; (c) replace the custom store with a tiny zustand store (useEditStore) which is battle-tested with React 18/19 and react-native-web; (d) hoist the edit intent into the (tabs) _layout.tsx as useState context so navigation and consumption happen in the same component tree without an external store at all.

action_items: FIX HIGH regression (repeated edits) - iteration-5 token+ref fix is INSUFFICIENT. Switch the prefill trigger in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx from a subscription effect to useFocusEffect so it reads the latest editStore snapshot every time the Inserisci tab gains focus. Concrete sketch: expose getEditRequest() in /app/frontend/src/editStore.ts (returns state); in Inserisci: import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router'; useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { const req = getEditRequest(); if (!req.id || req.token === 0 || handledTokenRef.current === req.token) return; const m = (data ?? []).find(x => x.id === req.id); if (!m) return; handledTokenRef.current = req.token; /* prefill same as today */ }, [data]));
ALTERNATIVE if focus-effect is undesirable: replace the custom useSyncExternalStore with zustand (yarn add zustand) and selector-based subscription; it works reliably on react-native-web.

Keep testIDs stable: edit-button-<id>, edit-banner, cancel-edit-button, save-measurement-button, glucose-input, delete-button-<id>, delete-confirm-modal, confirm-delete-button, cancel-delete-button, export-pdf-button.

After the next fix, retest the EXACT 4-subcase scenario (TEST A add 120 + 90, edit row1 -> 200, TEST B edit row2 shows banner+90, TEST C cancel, TEST D edit row1 shows banner+200). All four MUST pass.
critical_code_review_comments: src/editStore.ts: token-based snapshot design is correct and matches the iteration_4 recommendation; the implementation in isolation is fine.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx:90-104: the useEffect pattern with handledTokenRef is correct in theory. The empirical failure indicates the SUBSCRIBER callback itself is not firing on the second emission in react-native-web + Expo Router tabs. Driving prefill from useFocusEffect is more robust because it is guaranteed to run after router.navigate('/') lands on the screen.
app/(tabs)/storico.tsx:126-131: requestEdit + router.navigate('/') is fine and does not need to change.
No duplicate on update: verified count stayed at 2 after TEST A save.

success_rate.frontend: ~50% of required repeated-edit subcases (only TEST A passes; TEST B/C/D blocked by same root issue)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral AsyncStorage/localStorage measurements created per run, cleared via window.localStorage.clear() at the start of each test cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Minimal repro (viewport 390x844, URL https://insulin-daily.preview.emergentagent.com): (1) window.localStorage.clear(); reload. (2) In Inserisci: fill glucose-input=120, click moment-chip-prima_pranzo, click save-measurement-button. Then glucose-input=90, moment-chip-notte, save. (3) Click bottom 'Storico' tab. Query [data-testid^='edit-button-'] to get the 2 row ids (first one in list = newest = Notte 90, second = Prima Pranzo 120). (4) Click edit-button-<row1id> -> banner shows, glucose=90 (TEST A PASS). Fill glucose=200, click save-measurement-button, wait 1s. (5) Click Storico tab. Click edit-button-<row2id> -> banner is HIDDEN, glucose='', header='Nuova Misurazione' (TEST B FAIL). This is the exact iteration_4 symptom even after the token+ref refactor; the fix must change HOW prefill is triggered on tab return, not just WHAT the store emits.
rca_of_issue: The iteration-5 fix correctly makes editStore emit a token-stamped snapshot and gates the prefill with handledTokenRef, but the subscriber callback of useSyncExternalStore in Inserimento is NOT delivering the second emission in this react-native-web + Expo Router tabs environment (confirmed by two clean runs). This is an environment-level reliability issue with the subscribe path rather than a logic bug in the store. The robust fix is to drive the prefill from useFocusEffect in Inserisci (which fires deterministically after Storico calls router.navigate('/')), reading the current snapshot via a plain getter and still latching handledTokenRef for one-shot semantics. Alternatively, replace the hand-rolled store with zustand or hoist the intent state into the (tabs) layout.
